Sam (People Ops): New quick note: WFH stipend increase to $125/month effective next payroll. One-time home office cap kept at $350 (receipts required). If you're relocating across state or country, file the relocation intake before changing residence so we can run payroll/tax checks.

Tom (Eng): If I move states but stay 100% remote, do I still need manager approval?

Sam (People Ops): Yes. Manager sign-off + relocation intake. We need the move date to update withholding and benefits.

Aisha (Finance): Reminder: accountable-plan reimbursements need receipts within 60 days to be non-taxable. Lump sums are taxable unless gross-up arranged. For any cross-border moves, expect longer lead time to set up payroll.

Tom (Eng): Filing form now. Estimated move date 2024-11-01.

relocations-bot: automated: ticket RL-902 created for payroll change. ETA 3 business days after form verification.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks. We'll ping if Legal or Tax needs to review. If hiring and candidate requests relocation, pause offer finalization until People Ops confirms eligibility.

Tom (Eng): Got it, thanks!
